command: kubectl get pods,deployments,daemonsets,statefulsets -n wiki-83f4 -o json | jq -r '.. | select(.configMapRef? != null) | .configMapRef.name' 2>/dev/null | sort -u
kubectl get pods,deployments,daemonsets,statefulsets -n wiki-83f4 -o json | grep -o '"configMapRef"[^}]*' | grep -o '"name":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort -u
kubectl describe deployment wikiweb -n wiki-83f4 2>/dev/null | grep -i configmap
kubectl get deployment wikiweb -n wiki-83f4 -o yaml | grep -i configmap -A 2 -B 2
kubectl delete configmap import-rules page-templates-2023 -n wiki-83f4
